PLAN "Couch to 5K — 12 week run build"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Complete 5K run"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Run/Walk Intro":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          running 1x1..1 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walking 1x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Build Aerobic Base":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          running 1x1..1 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walking 1x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Sustained Walk/Short Runs":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          running 1x2..2 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walking 1x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Increase Run Time":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          running 1x2..3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walking 1x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Controlled Intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 12m

    WEEK 3:
